paragraphs: In [Pesachim 57a](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.57a.8) Abba Shaul ben Batnit said in the name of Abba Yosef ben Chanin: “Woe is me because of the house of Baitos … woe is me because of the house of Chanin” — they were high priests, etc.[^1]

notes.text: Abba Shaul ben Batnit reports Abba Yosef ben Chanin. The house of Chanin is one of several high-priestly families criticized in the passage.
